seed: Fresh private 1 MiB emulated flash from the respective linked package. A 1 ms seed shot reported zero flash operations. The two cases used the matching owner tag, the DnBOX/STILL record and the exact sample_sector and seed_splash bodies from tests/ui_inventory/startup_loop.c. Sample sector size 4096. Slot zero and shadow addresses are 0xC2000 and 0xB0000.
modelSource: The two firmware packages came from the serial stock builds. Package hashes were not retained before the executor disconnected.
applicationEntry: The emulator hands over at the packaged app entry after modeling the SPL. The stock crt0.S _start then sets stacks and calls fm1_cstart.

coldElite.case: Fresh factory flash without a sample shadow. The emulator's default key/PLAY inputs were enabled for this exploratory shot.
coldElite.scope: Timed SPI/LCD activity and execution in IRQs from the linked Elite image. The resulting LCD was not used as the sample-recovery frame oracle.

caseInputs.recover: Erased live sector, good shadow filled with 0x36 outside the valid one-zone header.
caseInputs.alreadyLive: Good live sector and distinct valid stale shadow filled with 0x59 outside the header.

sampleRuns.inputScript: FM1_BENCH_KEYS was empty to suppress the default key/PLAY sequence.
sampleRuns.command: FM1_STRICT=1 FM1_BENCH_KEYS='' FM1_DUMPRAM=<case>/ram.bin fm1-live --fwsc <model>.fwsc --mhz 360 --lcd-only --shot 1500 --record frames --flash flash.bin

readback.comparison: Each RGB565 value matched the seven-case host splash. 384 RGB888 pixels differed in an exported low bit by at most one channel level. The difference box was x101..138, y98..146.
readback.referenceEmulatorRgbDerivation: Expand the verified archived RGB565 values using fm1-live's bit replication. The computed full digest agrees with the recorded 10-character prefix. The direct Elite check compared every source pixel in RGB565.

readback.stage: Same sampled splash hash prefix at 416 ms
Same sampled splash hash prefix at 416 ms
Capture read back through LCD clear at 368 ms. A complete splash was not checked.

sampleRuns.scope: The printed SHA prefix is a diagnostic identifier. The pixel-by-pixel comparison was performed for Elite recovery. A recorded process exited on signal 9 before its ordinary-frame and final-flash receipts were obtained. No model/fixture pair has an accepted ordinary-frame or flash-persistence result from fm1-live in this receipt.

replayNote: The portable replay uses an independent single-shot checkpoint to avoid storing a movie. The stock package, sample generator and RGB565 comparison were exercised in the recording above. The packaged single-shot wrapper awaits an end-to-end run.
hardware: The emulator models the processor and peripherals. Panel color/timing, physical scan and power-loss behavior on SMK hardware remain open.
